description: Veterinarian license verification from official state open data — Colorado (DORA, VET licenses with degrees and discipline history) and Illinois (IDFPR: licensed veterinarians, controlled-substance licenses, certified veterinary technicians, ever-disciplined flag): license number, name, type, status, issue/renewal/expiry dates, city and discipline details. Search by license number, name or city; active licenses by default. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

activeOnly.description: true (default for name/city searches) = active licenses only
